Eternal Fire is a Turkish esports organization. The organization moved its headquarters to Hungary on October 16, 2024.

  • 2022

  • August 13th - Eternal Fire is founded with the signings of XANTARES, woxic, Calyx, imoRR, ISSAA, and bishop as coach. [1]
  • October 11th - Eternal Fire part ways with ISSAA. [2]
  • October 16th - Eternal Fire sign xfl0ud. [3]
  • January 22nd - Eternal Fire bench Calyx due to personal problems and add duggyversus from Eternal Fire Academy on trial as a replacement. [4]
  • January 26th - Calyx returns to the starting lineup. duggyversus returns to Eternal Fire Academy. [5]
  • February 5th - xfl0ud is moved to the bench due to his hand injury. Eternal Fire add colorzz from Eternal Fire Academy as a stand-in. [6]
  • February 23rd - Eternal Fire sign mini. [7]
  • March 6th - xfl0ud returns to the starting lineup. [8]
  • April 11th - mini retires from competitive Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and leaves Eternal Fire. [9]
  • July 4th - Eternal Fire part ways with Calyx. [10]
  • July 8th - Eternal Fire sign MAJ3R. [11]
  • July 10th - Eternal Fire part ways with bishop. [12]

  • October 31st - Eternal Fire bench paz and part ways with hardstyle. [17][18]
  • November 3rd - Eternal Fire transfer-list woxic by mutual agreement. [19]
